top_signal.title: Thinking about offering payment plans. No idea how to avoid the financial fallout.
top_signal.summary: I run a small web design business on the side while in grad school full time, so my hours are limited. It’s been a year, with steady clients since February, repeat customers, and no bad reviews.   I did some market research, and the clearest signal from prospects was that they’d hire me if I offered payment plans. I can’t afford to front-load work and wait on payments, and I’ve dealt with late ones. For my next client, I’m testing a 50-30-20 split: 50% at kickoff, 30% before development starts, and 20% before launch.   For other freelancers and service-business owners:  Does that structure hold up, or would you change it?   What do you do when a payment is late or a card fails?   What tools do you use for saving a card and scheduling installments?    I’m fine paying a small monthly fee if it’s worth it, or doing a bit more manual work to keep costs down.  I’m not looking for coaching or courses, just real experience from people who’ve dealt with this.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/ProtagonistNProgress       [link]       [comments]
